reason: I'm not handing real money to an AI agent from a name I've never heard of, with no reviews and no broker named yet. A cute pet and a kill switch don't tell me who pays if the agent screws up.
objection: Who is liable if the agent loses money? The page doesn't name the licensed broker, doesn't say what protection my account has, and there are zero reviews from people who've used it with real money.
would_change_my_mind: A named, known licensed broker holding the accounts with SIPC coverage, written terms on who covers agent errors, and a solid stack of independent reviews from real-money users.
